description: Face fix, step 1 of 2 — FREE. Finds one person in a clip FilmLab generated and plans which stretches of their face a redraw would improve (small or drifting faces). Give the generated clip (video_id) and a reference photo of that person (foto_url — an image FilmLab generated, e.g. a character sheet view from lab_get_character_sheet). Uploaded clips or photos are refused with face_fix_nur_generiert before anything happens: for now only material created in FilmLab is accepted. ASYNCHRONOUS: returns a job_id; poll it with lab_get_job until done. Then call lab_face_fix_freigeben with get_cost to see the price per stretch and let the human confirm. Nothing is charged by this tool.

foto_url.description: Reference photo of the person, an image generated in FilmLab (address from lab_get_character_sheet or lab_list_assets). It must show the face clearly.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string.

video_id.description: Id of the finished generated video row to improve (from lab_job_status or lab_review_queue) — positive integer as string.

name: lab_face_fix
title: Plan Face Fix
